text:
**Subjects:**
- Three individuals: one adult female (back view, black sleeveless top, hair in bun), one adult male (side/back view, light-colored short-sleeve shirt), and one infant (held by male, facing outward).
- One stroller: dark canopy with gold/yellow trim; visible wheels and frame structure.

**Setting:**
- Outdoor park environment adjacent to a body of water (lake or pond).
- Background features blurred trees and distant structures under bright daylight.
- Foreground includes grassy ground and partial trunk of tree on right edge.

**Lighting:**
- Natural daylight, high-key illumination from upper left.
- Shadows cast toward lower right; subjects partially shaded by tree canopy.
- Bright highlights on water surface and foliage.

**Composition:**
- Asymmetrical framing: stroller occupies left third; human group centered-right; tree trunk vertical element at far right.
- Depth layers: foreground (stroller/tree), midground (people), background (water/trees).
- Subjects oriented away from camera except infant; gaze direction implied toward water.
- Framed through negative space between stroller and tree trunk.
